question: In December 2021, which state government passed the Bill for the creation of two new districts named Pakyong and Soreng?
solution:
The correct answer is** "Sikkim".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The total number of districts is now raised to six in Sikkim state.
 
• These districts are created by** Sikkim Krantikari Morcha Government.**
 
• The existing four districts are also renamed: the east district is renamed Gangtok district, the west as Gyalshing, the north as Mangan, and the south as Namchi.
 
• This decision was taken to meet the requirements of the growing population for better service.
 
• Soreng district is carved out from the previous West district.
 
• Soreng will have two subdivisions **- Mangalbarey and Soreng**
 
• Pakyong will have three subdivisions - **Pakyong, Rongli, and Rangpo**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some current affairs:
 
 
• The Tamil Nadu government implemented the first project to conserve **Nilgiri Tahr**.
 
• **IACP 2022 Award** is won by Chattisgarh police.
 
• **Prahari app and BSF **manuals are launched by Home Minister Amit Shah.
 
• The 14 Km long Angu; Balram rail link was inaugurated.
